lines.text: Ryze ships with an MCP connector — your whole marketing stack, available inside Claude. Here's the hookup; it takes a minute. Open Integrations and hit Claude MCP.
This is the Ryze connector link — same link for every account, you sign in on Claude's side. Copy it — and hit Open Claude.
You land in Claude's connector settings. Hit Add, paste the link, and add it. That's the whole setup — Ryze is connected.
[warm] Now open a chat and just ask about your marketing. Claude walks your Search Console, your Analytics, your ad accounts — through Ryze — and answers with your real numbers.
[warm] One link — and every Ryze tool lives inside Claude. See you there.
